={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.85, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 1024, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "You find the sharpest angle on a rough idea. Most content is boring because the angle is boring, not because the idea is.

RULES
- The angle must be ONE complete, grammatical sentence stating one claim. Read it back to yourself. If it does not make literal sense in plain English, throw it away and write another one.
- Never use the shape A over B unless A and B are genuine opposites. Complexity over fragility is nonsense. Complexity over reliability is a claim.
- It must be arguable. If nobody could disagree with it, it is not an angle.
- Do NOT repeat or rephrase any angle listed under ALREADY USED. Find a different way in.
- Never invent a statistic, a date, a client name, a product name or a story. one_proof_needed names what proof would be needed, it never supplies it.
- Never write an em dash or en dash.

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: angle, angle_why, who_it_is_for, the_claim, one_proof_needed, what_to_avoid.

BRAND:
" + $json.brand_context + "

THE IDEA:
" + $json.idea + "

ALREADY USED, do not repeat these:
" + $json.recent_angles }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.75, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "Write one LinkedIn post in the voice described below. A validator checks it mechanically straight after you, so follow every rule exactly.

VOICE RULES, follow all of them:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.style_text + "

HOW TO USE THE ANGLE
The angle is your thesis. It is NOT your opening line. Never open the post by restating the angle, and never open with a reworded version of it. Open with something concrete, a situation, an observation or a consequence, and let the angle become obvious by the third or fourth line.

HARD RULES
- Maximum " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.limit_linkedin + " characters including line breaks.
- NEVER invent a number, a date, a client name, a product name or a specific story. The validator rejects any digit that does not appear in THE IDEA below. If you have no real example, make the point without one.
- Every claim must be one you could defend without data you were not given.
- Never use any of these words or phrases: " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.banned_text + "
- No emojis. No hashtags. No em dash or en dash. No square bracket placeholders. No shouting in capitals.
- Do not open with a question.

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: post, opening_two_lines, word_count.

BRAND:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.brand_context + "

THE IDEA:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.idea + "

THE ANGLE TO ARGUE, do not quote it:
" + (($json.candidates && $json.candidates[0] && $json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) || "No angle was returned. Write straight from the idea.") }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.95, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 1024, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "The post below ALREADY HAS an opening line. Your job is to offer three BETTER alternatives to it, and say in one line why each would work.

ABSOLUTE RULE, the validator rejects these automatically
- Never return a sentence that already appears anywhere in the post. A hook that copies the post is worthless, the owner already has it.
- The three hooks must be different from each other, not three rewordings of one idea.

USE THESE THREE MECHANISMS, one each
1. A specific concrete detail or comparison.
2. A flat contradiction of what the reader expects.
3. A small real moment, something that happened.

HARD RULES
- Each hook is at most " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.limit_hook + " characters.
- Never a question. Never any of these: " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.banned_text + "
- NEVER invent a number, a date or a name. The validator rejects any digit that is not in the idea.
- No emojis, no hashtags, no em dash or en dash.

Return ONLY valid JSON with key hooks, an array of exactly three objects each with hook, mechanism and why.

VOICE RULES:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.style_text + "

THE IDEA:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.idea + "

THE POST, whose opening you must beat and must not copy:
" + (($json.candidates && $json.candidates[0] && $json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) || $('4 Build the brief').first().json.idea) }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.9, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "A long form post already exists that ARGUES the angle below. You have deliberately not been shown it.

Your two pieces must do COMPLETELY DIFFERENT JOBS from that post and from each other. If all three pieces argue the same case, the owner has been handed the same thing three times and the work is worthless. This is the single most important instruction here.

INSTAGRAM CAPTION, the job is ONE CONCRETE SCENE
- Do NOT argue the case. Do NOT explain the angle. Do NOT list reasons.
- Pick one specific, ordinary, physical moment where this problem shows up, and describe it. A desk, a screen, a Monday morning, a message that arrives, a thing someone does with their hands.
- Stay inside that one moment for most of the caption. Let the reader draw the conclusion themselves.
- End with one short line that names what the moment was really about.
- Maximum " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.limit_instagram + " characters. First line must work alone.

WHATSAPP BROADCAST, the job is ONE ACTION
- Do NOT argue the case either. These people already agree with you.
- Give them exactly one thing to DO this week. Name the step. Say what they will see once they have done it.
- Practical and instructional, like a note from someone who has done it.
- Maximum " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.limit_whatsapp + " characters. No greeting, no sign off. Use line breaks, at least two short paragraphs.

SO, TO BE EXPLICIT
The post argues. The caption shows one scene. The broadcast gives one instruction. Three different jobs. If your caption contains the words because, therefore, costs, or a list of reasons, you have written an argument and you must start again.

HARD RULES FOR BOTH
- NEVER invent a number, a date, a client name or a product name. The validator rejects any digit that is not in THE IDEA below.
- Never any of these: " + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.banned_text + "
- No emojis, no hashtags, no em dash or en dash, no square bracket placeholders. Do not open with a question.

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: instagram, whatsapp, instagram_scene, whatsapp_action.
instagram_scene is three words naming the scene you chose. whatsapp_action is three words naming the action you gave.

VOICE RULES:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.style_text + "

THE IDEA:
" + $('4 Build the brief').first().json.idea + "

THE ANGLE:
" + (($('5 Agent 1 Angle Finder').first().json.candidates && $('5 Agent 1 Angle Finder').first().json.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) || $('4 Build the brief').first().json.idea) }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.5, topP: 0.9, topK: 20, maxOutputTokens: 3072, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "You are the last pass before anything reaches the owner. A validator has already checked these pieces. Below are the exact violations it found.

THE THREE PIECES HAVE THREE DIFFERENT JOBS. Hold this in mind above everything else.
- The LinkedIn post ARGUES the case.
- The Instagram caption shows ONE CONCRETE SCENE and never argues.
- The WhatsApp broadcast gives ONE ACTION to take this week and never argues.
If two of them are making the same case in different words, the owner has been handed the same thing twice. That is the worst failure here.

YOUR JOB
1. Fix every violation listed.
2. If a violation says two pieces say the same thing, REWRITE the offending piece to do its own job. For the caption that means throwing out the reasoning and describing one ordinary physical moment instead. For the broadcast that means throwing out the reasoning and giving one concrete step to take this week. Rewording is what caused the violation, so rewording will not clear it.
3. If a violation names an invented number, DELETE it and rephrase. Never swap in another invented number.
4. If a violation says one solid block, add line breaks.
5. Return all three pieces and all three hooks, fixed or unchanged. Never return an empty field.
6. In changes, say in plain words what you altered.

HARD RULES, the validator runs again and anything still failing is thrown away
- linkedin at most " + $json.limit_linkedin + " characters, instagram at most " + $json.limit_instagram + ", whatsapp at most " + $json.limit_whatsapp + ", each hook at most " + $json.limit_hook + ".
- No digit may appear anywhere unless it appears in THE IDEA.
- No hook may repeat a sentence from the post or another hook.
- Never any of these: " + $json.banned_text + "
- Forbidden entirely: " + $json.forbid_text + ".

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: linkedin, instagram, whatsapp, hooks (array of three objects with hook, mechanism, why), changes (array of strings).

THE IDEA:
" + $json.idea + "

VOICE RULES:
" + $json.style_text + "

VIOLATIONS THE VALIDATOR FOUND:
" + $json.pass1_text + "

THE CURRENT PIECES:
" + JSON.stringify({ linkedin: $json.pieces.linkedin, instagram: $json.pieces.instagram, whatsapp: $json.pieces.whatsapp, hooks: $json.hooks }) }] }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { temperature: 0.8, topP: 0.95, topK: 40, maxOutputTokens: 1024, responseMimeType: "application/json" }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: "You are an art director. Write the brief for ONE image that will sit above the social post below.

WHAT MAKES THIS IMAGE WORK
- It must carry the IDEA visually, not decorate it. A reader who sees only the image should feel the tension in the post.
- Concrete over abstract. A real object, a real scene, a real contrast. Never a glowing brain, never a robot, never a handshake, never floating icons.
- One subject. One clear focal point. Clean empty space in the upper third so text can sit there.
- Style: editorial photography or clean flat vector. Muted palette with one strong accent colour. No stock photo gloss.

RULES
- image_prompt is one rich paragraph describing subject, composition, lighting, palette and mood. Describe only what is visible.
- Put NO text, words, letters or numbers in the image. State that explicitly at the end of image_prompt.
- overlay_text is at most six words the owner could place on it themselves. Never a hashtag.
- alt_text is one plain sentence describing the image for a screen reader.
- Never write an em dash or en dash.

Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: image_prompt, overlay_text, alt_text, why_this_image.

THE IDEA:
" + $json.idea + "

THE ANGLE:
" + $json.angle_text + "

THE POST:
" + $json.linkedin }] }] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ generationConfig: { responseModalities: ["TEXT", "IMAGE"] }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: $json.image_prompt }] }] }) }}
